ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Sep-13-2011 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name for a Minor.
Dept. 514, Judge: ELLEN CHAITIN, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha , CSR: B. Fields, #7235

Petitioner Chao Lei present in pro per as Guardian Ad Litem for and with the minor Ying Zi Lei, and with Cantonese Interpreter Jenna Zhang, was placed under oath and examined.
No appearance by Co-Petitioner/Father: Qi Yen Lei, but had signed the Petition consented to the name change for the minor.
Proof of Publication was filed.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of the Minor to: Wendy Yingzi Lei.
Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.
